description: Sends a bug or idea about SEO Skill itself to its maintainer, with your proposed fix. Show the person the text first and send only if they agree; leave out keys, tokens and site data they didn't agree to share. Hosted and linked accounts send the account email.

details.description: What you called, what happened, what you expected, and the fix you propose.

summary.description: One line: what is wrong or missing.

tool.description: Optional. The tool or command it is about.
